notes.title: Thank you & new demo 🚚
notes.content:
Hello, Adventurers!

First of all, a big thank you to everyone who has bought, supported, streamed and reviewed Firebird! We are happy to read your feedback and hope you had a good time on the road of myths & magic.

[b]If you want to support us, you can leave a positive review on Steam to let us know what was your favorite parts of the game![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/04cb981180a6b3833d6ffd133dd4e3ac8e154c3d.png[/img]

[h3]A new demo on the page[/h3]

We have decided to update the demo because the previous demo no longer represented the whole game experience.

[list]
[*] We added parts of the game that reflected the “icy road trip” experience better
[*] Firebird also puts the accent on myths and legends, so you will meet a few of the colorful characters
[*] You are able to choose destinations that will lead you to more or less dangerous outcomes!
[/list]

To the new people who just found out about the game, we hope you’ll want to have a longer road trip with this short preview of the game! ❄️

You can join our [url=https://discord.gg/bWq96962ad]Discord server[/url] if you want to share your thoughts about it!

Hello adventurers!

[list]
[*] Untriggered achievements: "The end of the journey" and "Explorer" are showing now.

- Either it is detected when you start a new game if you explored everything on the map in previous runs, and will also unlock "The end of the journey" and "Chernobog"

notes.title: Firebird is OUT NOW! + developer livestream tomorrow
notes.content:
Hi Adventurers!

Great news for you today! Our magical road trip Firebird is HERE!

Are you ready to embark on a rich and folkloric adventure aboard your Firebird? Are you ready to switch back and forth between myth and reality? All your choices will be important to your smooth progress in the Great North, without forgetting resource management!

Check out the trailer and its Audio Described version :

[previewyoutube=S4XQramBB3Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Meet Mariska and Vassilissa[/h3]

Embark with Mariska and Vassilissa aboard the Firebird, in their road trip in the Great North in search of a lost village, prey to the dangers of these sacred lands.

These two young women are very different and yet! Mariska, a convoy driver in her Firebird truck, travels the snowy roads to survive. Vassilissa is trying to save her village by asking Mariska for help. Their history makes them who they are, with their own beliefs.

Their unexpected friendship will be put to the test during their journey aboard the Firebird.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/2aacf2c67071aa867f2c3190c119878f6c4a1330.gif[/img]

[h3]Explore magical landscapes[/h3]

You can explore the snowy landscapes of the Great North, from the industrial city of Norislk to the most sacred lands hiding legendary creatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/3bb5a335497fbb478b931f6330a58d094779c86e.gif[/img]

[h3]Keep a close eye on your truck[/h3]

Travel around the steppes of the Great North with your truck. Pay attention to its condition and the gas, and choose the best route. Will you manage to get your truck to its destination without succumbing to the dangers of this hostile land?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/f246701420ba45c80b558ce26ac80ad2b683d548.gif[/img]

[h3]Firebird launch discount[/h3]

To celebrate this magical event, Firebird has a -20% launch discount! For those, who haven’t joined the road trip yet, it is time to embark!

Also, [b]we plan to stream the game in French tomorrow, August 3 at 5:00 pm (CET)[/b] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/fibretigre]on FibreTigre's channel[/url]. Emmanuel, Narrative Designer at Ludogram and FibreTigre, writer of Firebird, will play the game and answer your questions!

We want to say thank you to all of you who are with us on this long trip alongside 💗

[i][b]To support us, you can spread the word about the game and leave a positive review on Steam and tell us what you enjoyed during your icy road trip ❄[/b][/i]

And don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/bWq96962ad]Discord server[/url] to share your thoughts about the game with us 💙

notes.title: Demo accessibility update | July 28th 2023
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1633860/view/3658660471427462762]previous Steam news[/url], we mentioned that Firebird will be accessible to visually-impaired people and added a few accessibility features.

We added a new addition to these features and wanted to inform you about it.

Here is what we originally announced as accessibility features:
[list]
[*] Screen reader detection on the first launch
- Menu, dialogues, narrations, map
[*] Able/Disable scenery shaking
[*] Able/Disable characters shaking
[*] Able/Disable text shaking
[*] Able/Disable transparency
[*] Able/Disable particles
[/list]

Regarding the new feature, [b]you'll be now able to play with one hand with a keyboard[/b].

We'd be happy to read your thoughts about these features on our social accounts or the Steam forum!

notes.title: July Devlog | Firebird will be accessible to visually-impaired people!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers,

Last month, we mentioned during the Steam Next Fest news that the demo was accessible for visually-impaired people. We have good news! Not only it was implemented in the demo, but so it will be in the full game!

[h3]Why did we make this choice?[/h3]
The accessibility issue in video games is still underrated. LudAccess, which specializes in visually-impaired issues in games, visited us earlier this year. Since we love to learn new things, we have decided to gain new skills to extend the audience of this and our future games.

[h3]What does this change in the game settings?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Screen reader detection on the first launch
- Menu, dialogues, narrations, map
- Set and character descriptions, credits and video descriptions (WIP)
[*] Able/Disable scenery shaking
[*] Able/Disable characters shaking
[*] Able/Disable text shaking
[*] Able/Disable transparency
[*] Able/Disable particles
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/1f162aa7d2961c9ed478903c4cfdb9f5c731cc70.gif[/img]

We would like to know what you think about these features, so if you ever use them once the game is out, feel free to share your thoughts on [url=https://ludogramgames.carrd.co/]our social accounts[/url]!

notes.title: The choices and their secrets | June Devlog
notes.content:
Hi Adventurers !

In this devlog, we'll elaborate a little more about using the map in Firebird.

When you open the map, you'll have a choice of 1 or 2 destinations. They are delimited by zones as you progress through the Great North.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/bab48c6bd5a0c2b8bb049c578e6014ade2e62fe2.png[/img]

First, you can check out your resources level at the bottom of the screen. From left to right: money, gas and truck condition.

Then, all the interactive choices lead to different situations! In the screenshot above, you can see a wolf drawn on the map. This means that we enter the wolves' territory and we might encounter them! But there are also mysterious icons that will give a hint of the place you're about to discover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/5547523be036c0fe787c6b6c2d675fe3b97f1a98.gif[/img]

Finally, the deeper you go in the Great North, the more often you change zones. Slavic myths and legends will become even more alive. Will you recognize them? 👀

notes.title: No gas, no trip! 🚚 | May Devlog
notes.content:
As you go through the Grand North, you'll need to pay attention to your resources, especially gas. The less gas you have, the more complicated your trip will be. And if you ever have an empty tank, it's game over!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/b747c24d2809c641682aee8b89da217b6323f61c.gif[/img]

[b]How to check out the gas level?[/b]
When you pick a new destination on the map, you will have an overview of your resources. Every time you go somewhere, your gas level diminishes by 1.

[b]How can I find gas?[/b]
If you're curious and brave enough, some of the seemingly difficult choices can lead you to a jerrycan of gas! It means that the adventure continues.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/6353b7562bd528bad3578f46fb53ed204832eb60.gif[/img]

[b]What about the state of my truck?[/b] 

Your truck has a general state. By facing bandits, having small crashes or making the wrong choices, your truck's state will deteriorate. The more damage you take during your trip, the more state points your truck will lose. Your trip might stop earlier than expected if not fixed! Maybe you will find useful resources to repair it.

[b]Imporant information[/b] 

[b]Firebird was selected for the 5th edition of the AG French Direct that will take place on May 17th![/b] You don't want to miss out on this date since a special video will be showcased during the event. 👀

Read more here ➡️ https://www.actugaming.net/un-ag-french-direct-le-17-mai-2023-pour-une-conference-riche-en-annonces-de-jeux-559816/

notes.title: 🚚 Firebird will release in Summer 2023!
notes.content:
Be ready to drive throughout the Grand North with your loyal truck, because [b]Firebird will be out this Summer![/b]

So, if you have not done it yet, you still can wishlist the game to not miss the release and get a wave of freshness during the summer! [b]The demo remains up on the Steam page[/b] if you want to visit the first stops of this icy road trip. ❄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/1fc46050600acb59e1674b26c5d5a9a3ff386e4f.gif[/img]

[b]Why did we postpone the release?[/b]

As we were almost ready to ship the game, the Russian-Ukrainian conflict began and didn’t allow us to release the game serenely, in accordance with our values.

[b]More updates and exciting events soon[/b]! We remain open to questions on our [url=”https://discord.gg/bWq96962ad”]Discord server[/url]. Thanks for your patience and your support!
